Connor / team / Elena —

Thanks for the context and the redline. Quick summary from Legal after a brief review:

- We can accept a DBA reference for PO routing as an operational accommodation, but the MSA must retain the canonical legal entity name for indemnity and tax purposes.
- Proposed fix: add a short subsection to Section 2 (Parties & Notices) that reads: "For procurement and purchase order routing only, Redwood may accept orders referencing an affiliated trade name or DBA, provided that such orders are ultimately attributable to the legal entity executing this Agreement."
- This language keeps our legal protections intact while addressing ProcureIT's operational requirement.

Please note: we should not accept a statement that the DBA is the legal entity. The clause above keeps the legal entity unchanged.

Operational request for Luke/Laura: to ensure ProcureIT's Ariba mapping is aligned, please confirm which portal field will carry the DBA value (e.g., "Company Name" vs "Doing Business As" custom field) and if ProcureIT can forward the raw PO XML so we can validate matching rules.

I've also attached an updated field-mapping template (ProcureIT_Ariba_FieldMap_v2.xlsx) with suggestions on where to place the DBA element.

Attachments: ProcureIT_Ariba_FieldMap_v2.xlsx

—Marissa

Subject: Re: Ariba activation — quick follow-up on DBA handling

Marissa — that wording looks good to me and should satisfy ProcureIT's audit team. A couple of practical follow-ups:

1) Our Ariba instance will populate the <BuyerCompanyName> element with the entity that created the supplier record. We can add a custom "DBA" attribute, but it won't be included in the standard PO XML unless we map it into an existing tag (we typically put it in <BuyerAdditionalInfo>).

2) I'm attaching a sanitized PO example (PO-example.xml) showing how we can surface the DBA in <BuyerAdditionalInfo>. If Redwood is comfortable with the clause Marissa proposed, we can proceed to stage gating and enable automated PO acceptance next week.

Thanks — happy to join a short call if you want to walk the mappings.

Best,
Elena
